questions.question:
Convert the sentence into Interrogative sentence. 
“Growing plants that require very little attention has become almost a given for those who desire verdant comfort at 
home.” 
Read the passage and answer the following questions: 
In an age when city residents often complain about their lack of time, growing plants that require very little attention 
has become almost a given for those who desire verdant comfort at home. Some varieties, blessed with exceptional 
toughness, can survive with minimal care, reducing the worry that often comes with gardening. 
The snake plant (Sansevieria trifasciata), for example, is nearly unbreakable. It flourishes in different light settings 
and tolerates irregular watering without losing its firm, elegant form. Similarly, pothos (Epipremnum aureum), with 
its rich trailing leaves, adjusts easily to both low-light corners and brighter areas, continuing photosynthesis with 
steady persistence. 
Another notable choice is aloe vera, whose fleshy leaves store water, making frequent watering unnecessary. Beyond 
its decorative appeal, aloe vera offers medicinal value, as its gel is prized for soothing and healing the skin. Even the 
ZZ plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia), as if carved from glossy green wax, thrives on neglect, enduring long dry spells 
and dim light without capitulating to decay. 
The charm of these plants lies not only in the beauty they add but also in the message they quietly convey: resilience 
can be just as captivating as delicacy. By nurturing them, one enters a calm partnership in which human care plays a 
secondary role, while nature’s own processes sustain life with effortless grace.
options:
(a) Growing plants that require very little attention has not become almost a given for those who desire verdant 
comfort at home?

(b) Is growing plants that require very little attention has become almost a given for those who desire verdant 
comfort at home?

(c) Why growing plants that require very little attention has become almost a given for those who desire verdant 
comfort at home?

(d) Has growing plants that require very little attention become almost a given for those who desire verdant comfort 
at home?
questions.correct_answer:
(d) Has growing plants that require very little attention become almost a given for those who desire verdant comfort 
at home?
